arxiv-2107-05531.title: Shared Control for Bimanual Telesurgery with Optimized Robotic Partner Thanks: This research was partly supported by the European Commission grants H2020 PH-CODING (FETOPEN 829186), NIMA (FETOPEN 899626) and UK EPSRC grant FAIR-SPACE EP/R026092/1. (Corresponding author: Yanpei Huang and Xiaoxiao Che
arxiv-2107-05531.creator: Ziwei Wang, Yanpei Huang, Xiaoxiao Cheng
arxiv-2107-05531.description: Abstract Traditional telesurgery relies on the surgeon’s full control of robot on the patient’s side, which tends to increase surgeon fatigue and may reduce the efficiency of the operation. This paper introduces a Robotic Partner (RP) to facilitate intuitive bimanual telesurgery, aiming at reducing the surgeon workload and enhancing surgeon-assisted capability.

arxiv-2204-00521.title: Comment on “First-order methods almost always avoid strict saddle points” Thanks: This research was supported by the Beijing Natural Science Foundation under grant Z180005, and the National Natural Science Foundation of China under grants 12171021 and 11822103.
arxiv-2204-00521.creator: Jinyang Zheng, Yong Xia
arxiv-2204-00521.description: Abstract The analysis on the global stability of Riemannian gradient descent method in manifold optimization (i.e., it avoids strict saddle points for almost all initializations) due to Lee et al. (Math. Program. 176:311-337) is corrected. Moreover, an explicit condition on the step-size is presented by the newly introduced retraction L-smooth property.

arxiv-2205-03392.title: Gravothermal evolution of dark matter halos with differential elastic scattering
arxiv-2205-03392.creator: Hai-Bo Yu
arxiv-2205-03392.description: Abstract We study gravothermal evolution of dark matter halos in the presence of differential self-scattering that has strong velocity and angular dependencies. We design controlled N-body simulations to model Rutherford and Møller scatterings in the halo, and follow its evolution in both core-expansion and -collapse phases.

arxiv-2307-10870.title: Nonlinear Meta-learning Can Guarantee Faster Rates
arxiv-2307-10870.creator: Dimitri Meunier dimitri.meunier.21@ucl.ac.uk, Zhu Li zhu.li@ucl.ac.uk Arthur Gretton arthur.gretton@gmail.com Samory Kpotufe samory@columbia.edu
arxiv-2307-10870.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Dimitri Meunier dimitri.meunier.21@ucl.ac.uk, Zhu Li zhu.li@ucl.ac.uk Arthur Gretton arthur.gretton@gmail.com Samory Kpotufe samory@columbia.edu. Many recent theoretical works on meta-learning aim to achieve guarantees in leveraging similar representational structures from related tasks towards simplifying a target task. The main aim of theoretical guarantees on the subject is to establish the extent to which convergence rates—in learning a common representation— may scale with the number N N of tasks (as well as the number of samples per task).

arxiv-2405-04056.description: Abstract ∗ These authors contributed equally. Deep Learning has been a critical part of designing inverse design methods that are computationally efficient and accurate. arxiv-2506-01206.title: Mamba Drafters for Speculative Decoding
arxiv-2506-01206.creator: Daewon Choi, Seunghyuk Oh, Saket Dingliwal, Jihoon Tack, Kyuyoung Kim, Woomin Song, Seojin Kim, Insu Han, Jinwoo Shin, Aram Galstyan, Shubham Katiyar, Sravan Babu Bodapati
arxiv-2506-01206.description: Abstract Speculative decoding has emerged as a promising approach to accelerating large language model (LLM) generation using a fast drafter while maintaining alignment with the target model’s distribution. However, existing approaches face a trade-off: external drafters offer flexibility but can suffer from slower drafting, while self-speculation methods use drafters tailored to the target model but require re-training.

arxiv-2508-18053.title: Investigating Optical and Ring-Down Gravitational Wave Properties of a Rotating Black Hole in a Dehnen Galactic Dark Matter Halo
arxiv-2508-18053.creator: Mrinnoy M. Gohain, Dhruba Jyoti Gogoi, Kalyan Bhuyan, Prabwal Phukon
arxiv-2508-18053.description: Abstract We present a comprehensive study of the optical and dynamical properties of a rotating black hole immersed in a Dehnen-type (1,4,0) galactic dark matter halo, modeled by a double power-law density profile commonly used to describe realistic galactic cores.

arxiv-2510-00855.title: Can World Models Benefit VLMs for World Dynamics?
arxiv-2510-00855.creator: Kevin Zhang, Kuangzhi Ge, Xiaowei Chi, Renrui Zhang, Shaojun Shi, Zhen Dong, Sirui Han, Shanghang Zhang
arxiv-2510-00855.description: Abstract Trained on internet-scale video data, generative world models are increasingly recognized as powerful world simulators that can generate consistent and plausible dynamics over structure, motion, and physics. This raises a natural question: with the advent of strong video foundational models, might they supplant conventional vision encoder paradigms for general-purpose multimodal understanding?

pmc-11471162.title: Regulation of 11β-HSD1 reductase and the HPA axis by long-snake moxibustion in kidney-yang deficiency rats
pmc-11471162.creator: Hui Huang, Jingjiao Zeng, Limei Tang, Lele Geng, Xijing Yu, Chenying Deng, Hang Liu, Ping Huang, Ensi Hong, Xiuwu Hu
pmc-11471162.description: BackgroundLong-snake moxibustion can improve hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal (HPA) axis function in patients with kidney-yang deficiency (KYDS). 11β-HSD1 controls the HPA axis by boosting CORT production via reductase activity. This study examined the impact of lengthy snake moxibustion on the hypothalamus-pituitary-adrenal axis in KYDS rats.

pmc-13407288.title: 程序性细胞死亡在卵巢癌铂耐药中的作用
pmc-13407288.creator: 娟 徐, 晅 周, 晨辉 罗
pmc-13407288.description: 卵巢癌是全球女性生殖系统中病死率最高的恶性肿瘤，化疗耐药特别是铂耐药是限制其预后改善的主要因素，相关机制涉及癌细胞对多种程序性细胞死亡途径的复杂调控与逃逸。双硫死亡由溶质载体家族7成员11(solute carrier family 7 member 11，SLC7A11)高表达在葡萄糖饥饿条件下触发，与铁死亡共享上游调控节点；钠死亡由瞬时受体电位阳离子通道亚家族M成员4(transient receptor potential cation channel subfamily M member 4，TRPM4)介导的Na⁺过载驱动，其作用尚待深入研究。其他程序性细胞死亡途径通过肿瘤蛋白p53、caspase家族、半胱氨酸天冬氨酸特异性蛋白酶、谷胱甘肽等关键调控分子交织成动态调控网络：自噬可抑制焦亡；铁死亡与焦亡可通过活性氧/NOD样受体热蛋白结构域相关蛋白3轴协同放大细胞杀伤效应。铁死亡与铜死亡共享谷胱甘肽代谢轴，铁死亡与双硫死亡的交互作用可在特定代谢压力下由拮抗向协同转换；铁死亡与钠死亡通过腺苷三磷酸耗竭、活性氧累积、线粒体损伤的级联反应相互促进；泛凋亡则可通过多死亡通路的同步激活，克服癌细胞对单一死亡模式的抵抗。系统综述双硫死亡、钠死亡、凋亡、自噬、坏死性凋亡、焦亡、铁死亡、铜死亡及泛凋亡等多种程序性死亡模式在卵巢癌铂耐药中的作用及其交互网络，有望为逆转铂耐药、优化临床治疗策略提供坚实的理论基础和潜在的转化方向。 卵巢癌(ovarian cancer，OC)是病死率最高的妇科恶性肿瘤，对全球女性健康构成重大威胁[1]。尽管手术联合铂类药物化疗对部分患者产生了比较好的疗效，但超过70%的患者会出现铂耐药[2]，导致5年生存率不足30%[3]。因此，研究并解决铂耐药问题是改善卵巢癌患者预后的关键。 铂类药物主要通过诱导DNA损伤、产生活性氧及破坏线粒体功能来激活癌细胞死亡程序[4]；然而，癌细胞能够通过多种途径削弱对这些死亡信号的应答，从而获得耐药表型。近年来，程序性细胞死亡(programmed cell death，PCD)的概念不断扩展，从经典的凋亡逐步延伸至自噬(autophagy)、坏死性凋亡(necroptosis)、焦亡(pyroptosis)、铁死亡(ferroptosis)、铜死亡(cuproptosis)、泛凋亡(panoptosis)，乃至近期提出的双硫死亡(disulfidptosis)和钠死亡(necrosis by sodium overload，NECSO)等多种形式。凋亡是经典的胱天蛋白酶(caspase)依赖性死亡，分为内源性的线粒体途径[由B淋巴细胞瘤-2(B-cell lymphoma-2，Bcl-2)家族蛋白调控线粒体内细胞色素c的释放]和外源性的死亡受体途径，其生理意义在于清除受损或多余细胞而不引发炎症[5]。在肿瘤中，凋亡逃逸是耐药的基础。自噬是一种溶酶体介导的降解过程，通过形成自噬体包裹受损的细胞器或蛋白质聚集体，维持代谢稳态和细胞生存，但在特定条件下也可促进细胞死亡；其双向调控作用在化疗抵抗中尤为突出[6]。坏死性凋亡由受体相互作用蛋白激酶1(receptor-interacting protein kinase，RIPK)1/RIPK3/混合谱系激酶结构域样蛋白(mixed lineage kinase domain-like protein，MLKL)级联信号驱动，导致膜破裂和内容物释放，兼具坏死形态与程序性调控，可作为凋亡受阻时的备用死亡途径[7]。焦亡则由焦孔素(gasdermin，GSDM)家族的GSDMD、GSDME介导，二者可被炎症小体下游激活的caspase-1或化疗诱导的caspase-3切割，在细胞膜上形成膜孔，从而导致白细胞介素1β(interleukin-1 beta，IL-1β)等促炎性细胞因子的释放，属于炎性死亡，在抗肿瘤免疫与耐药微环境中发挥双刃剑的作用[8]。铁死亡是一种铁依赖性的脂质过氧化驱动死亡，核心轴为胱氨酸/谷氨酸反向转运体(cystine/glutamate antiporter，System Xc⁻)-谷胱甘肽(glutathione，GSH)-谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶4(glutathione peroxidase 4，GPX4)，当GPX4失活或胱氨酸摄取受阻时，脂质过氧化物堆积导致膜破裂[9]；其与代谢重编程、免疫调节密切相关，已成为抑制耐药的研究热点。铜死亡是新定义的铜依赖性死亡，其调控机制不同于铁死亡、凋亡等经典死亡通路：胞内铜离子经铁氧还蛋白1(ferredoxin 1，FDX1)还原后与线粒体中的脂酰化蛋白直接结合，引发蛋白质毒性应激介导细胞死亡；铜转运体铜转运蛋白1(copper transport protein 1，CTR1)、铜离子转运ATP酶α/β肽(ATPase copper transporting alpha/beta，ATP7A/B)同时介导铂类药物摄取与外排，连接铜稳态与铂耐药[10]。 值得关注的是，双硫死亡与钠死亡是近期提出的2种非经典程序性细胞死亡方式，其在卵巢癌铂耐药中的潜在价值尚未被充分挖掘。其中，双硫死亡由溶质载体家族7成员11(solute carrier family 7 member 11，SLC7A11)高表达介导，在葡萄糖饥饿条件下触发，核心特征为胞内还原型烟酰胺腺嘌呤二核苷酸磷酸(reduced nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide phosphate，NADPH)耗竭与二硫化物应激导致细胞骨架崩解[11]，是目前唯一以肌动蛋白细胞骨架的二硫键应激为直接执行步骤的死亡方式，这使其在肿瘤治疗中具有独特的干预潜力。钠死亡则由瞬时受体电位阳离子通道亚家族M成员4(transient receptor potential cation channel subfamily M member 4，TRPM4)持续激活介导的Na⁺过载驱动，引发膜去极化和渗透性坏死[12]，是一种以离子稳态失衡为核心驱动的新型调节性坏死，其特殊性在于将离子毒性与线粒体代谢直接关联。 上述细胞死亡模式在卵巢癌铂耐药中并非孤立发挥作用，而是通过共享分子执行因子、代谢通路和炎症信号轴，构建出高度动态且具有代偿能力的死亡调控网络[13]。正是这种多通路间的相互协同与代偿，使得癌细胞在面对铂类药物压力时能够灵活切换死亡模式，最终形成耐药。因此，厘清不同死亡通路间的交互调控机制，对于开发联合靶向策略、打破癌细胞的耐药平衡具有重要意义。本文梳理了双硫死亡、钠死亡、凋亡、自噬、坏死性凋亡、焦亡、铁死亡、铜死亡和泛凋亡在卵巢癌铂耐药中的研究进展，聚焦其独特机制与交互网络，并在此基础上提出多通路协同干预的治疗新视角，为克服铂耐药、优化临床策略提供理论依据与转化思路。

pmc-13479919.title: Take-home naloxone (THN) ownership among a community-based cohort of sex workers who use drugs in metro vancouver: longitudinal trends and structural determinants (2017–2024)
pmc-13479919.creator: Sarah Moreheart, Kate Shannon, Andrea Krüsi, Wiebke Bartels, Haoxuan Zhou, Kanna Hayashi, Emily Luba, Colette Merrison, Shira Miriam Goldenberg
pmc-13479919.description: BackgroundSex workers who use drugs face disproportionately high overdose burden, driven by drug toxicity and intersecting structural factors in sex work and drug use environments. Given limited evidence regarding sex workers’ use of overdose prevention tools, including take-home naloxone (THN), we examined period prevalence, time trends, and structural factors longitudinally associated with THN ownership among sex workers over 7 years.
